title: feat: announce model retirements from the PR change table
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The news pipeline now reads future-dated RETIRE rows from merged PR model-change tables and checks each model ID against the merged catalog. It also processes announcement-only PRs without a shared/ change. The index keeps the latest announcement per model: a postponement retains the previous date, a Cancelled row withdraws the announcement, a removal PR settles it, and a retirement date that passes without removal is hidden. The model-management skill now says to announce only decided retirements and to record postponements or cancellations in a new row.
